entries.note: A segment directory whose manifest is missing, unparsable or a version this workspace does not read is reported in the listing as an error entry rather than dropped. The store is written by a live desktop that can be closed mid-drain, so an unfinished commit is a normal state and hiding it would leave a reader wondering where the disk space went. Only a directory that has vanished between the readdir and the read is reported as no longer present. readRecording is stricter, because a caller asked for that one: a missing directory is 404 and an unreadable manifest is 409.

This module only reads. The desktop writes segments directly to the project root it already has open, so no route uploads keyframe bytes through the service, and the routes stay a pure filesystem walk that the replaceable worker can serve from its own checkout. Ids are validated against a single-path-segment pattern before they reach the filesystem, and every path handed back is root-relative so a keyframe is fetched the way every other asset in this workspace is.
